index.serialization: LC-independent Unicode sorted Git ls-files --stage records, newline terminated

protectedRefs.serialization: Git for-each-ref refname/objectname, newline terminated; excludes only owned branch

worktree.serialization: sorted relative paths; compact sort_keys JSON per line, final newline
worktree.limits: Does not hash every cache/artifact/broadcast byte; links are lstat/readlink only, targets are not traversed. Four accepted executable artifacts separately SHA-256/Keccak checked.
